name.en: A 100 16th section: Neukölln interchange–Am Treptower Park
name.ro: A 100, secțiunea 16: nodul Neukölln–Am Treptower Park

description.en: A 3.2 km extension of the A 100 from the Neukölln interchange to Am Treptower Park in Berlin.
description.ro: O prelungire de 3,2 km a autostrăzii A 100, de la nodul Neukölln la Am Treptower Park, în Berlin.

sources.title: Autobahn GmbH: A100 16th section, Neukölln interchange to Am Treptower Park
Autobahn GmbH: A100 16th section opened to traffic

note.en: Autobahn GmbH reports 3.2 km for the project section. The OSM line follows one carriageway and measures about 2.93 km.
note.ro: Autobahn GmbH indică 3,2 km pentru sectorul proiectului. Linia OSM urmează o singură cale de rulare și măsoară aproximativ 2,93 km.

note.en: Autobahn GmbH reports the 16th section was opened to traffic.
note.ro: Autobahn GmbH anunță deschiderea pentru trafic a secțiunii 16.
